symptom: Host h1 unable to reach application service at Host h4 (10.0.0.40)
injected_fault: Switch s1 port eth3 administrative down
ground_truth_root_cause: Port s1-eth3 is DOWN; inter-switch trunk severed between switch s1 and s2.
remediation: ip link set dev s1-eth3 up

symptom: Host h2 ping to WAN service at 10.0.1.254 fails with 'connect: Network is unreachable'
injected_fault: Default gateway route stripped from host h2 routing table
ground_truth_root_cause: Missing default gateway via 10.0.0.1 on node h2.
remediation: ip route add default via 10.0.0.1 dev h2-eth0

symptom: Host h1 reports severe degraded performance, high latency variance, and heavy packet drop when communicating with h2 (10.0.0.20)
injected_fault: Severe synthetic jitter and packet loss via NetEm on s1-eth1
ground_truth_root_cause: Traffic control queuing discipline (NetEm) impairment on port s1-eth1 causing 35% packet loss and 180ms delay.
remediation: tc qdisc del dev s1-eth1 root

symptom: Host h3 can ping IP addresses directly, but hostname resolution for 'app.corp.local' times out
injected_fault: Misconfigured resolver pointing /etc/resolv.conf to unreachable IP 10.0.0.99
ground_truth_root_cause: Misconfigured nameserver IP in /etc/resolv.conf on host h3 pointing to unreachable address 10.0.0.99.

symptom: Host h2 has complete loss of connectivity; cannot ping local gateway (10.0.0.1) or any other host
ground_truth_root_cause: Port s1-eth2 is DOWN; access link connecting host h2 to switch s1 is severed.
remediation: ip link set dev s1-eth2 up

symptom: Host h1 can ping local hosts (h2, h4), but cannot reach upstream service at 10.0.1.254
injected_fault: Default gateway route stripped from host h1 routing table
ground_truth_root_cause: Missing default route via 10.0.0.1 on node h1.
remediation: ip route add default via 10.0.0.1 dev h1-eth0

symptom: Host h1 experiences packet fragmentation issues and MTU misconfiguration on its primary interface
ground_truth_root_cause: Subnet MTU mismatch; interface h1-eth0 configured with MTU 1200 instead of standard 1500.
remediation: ip link set dev h1-eth0 mtu 1500

symptom: Inter-switch communications between h1 and h3 (10.0.0.30) exhibit packet drop and high RTT latency
injected_fault: Synthetic NetEm impairment on trunk port s1-eth3 with 25% loss and 120ms delay
ground_truth_root_cause: NetEm synthetic impairment configured on inter-switch trunk port s1-eth3 with 25% loss and 120ms delay.
remediation: tc qdisc del dev s1-eth3 root

symptom: Host h1 ping to 10.0.0.40 succeeds, but nslookup app.corp.local fails with connection timeout
injected_fault: Invalid nameserver IP 192.168.1.1 configured in /etc/resolv.conf on host h1
ground_truth_root_cause: Invalid nameserver IP configured in /etc/resolv.conf on host h1 pointing to 192.168.1.1.

symptom: Internal host-to-host traffic works, but all hosts are unable to reach default gateway 10.0.0.1 or external WAN 10.0.1.254
injected_fault: Gateway uplink port s1-eth4 set to administrative down
ground_truth_root_cause: Switch port s1-eth4 connecting to gateway router gw1 is DOWN.
remediation: ip link set dev s1-eth4 up
